```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
# create directories

dir.create("../zip", showWarnings = TRUE, recursive = FALSE, mode = "0777")

```

```{r}
# xlsx files for oral drug, outpatient 
#　内服　外来 院外　制年齢

# 11th 2024
# "https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/12400000/001712211.zip"

url_drug_zip <- c("https://www.mhlw.go.jp/content/12400000/001712211.zip")

```

```{r}
file_drug_zip <- url_drug_zip %>% str_extract("00[:digit:]+\\.zip")

path_drug_zip <- paste0("../zip/", file_drug_zip)
```

```{r}
for (i in 1:length(url_drug_zip)){
  download.file(url_drug_zip[i], path_drug_zip[i], mode = "wb")
  print(paste(file_drug_zip[i], "downloaded"))
}
```
